thread:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout alert: inference-service/canary group showing elevated 5xx starting at 1935678901. image tag: gcr.io/redwood/inference:canary-20260314.
maya: paging oncall — I’m on it.
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: P1 — Canary 5xx spike detected (auto-page to oncall).
jonah: oncall here, what’s the signal?
deploy-bot: 5xx concentrated on canary pods; traces show 'unhandled EOF while parsing request body' at model-proxy. Approx start 1935678901.
serena: CI reported success but last push had a retry due to registry timeout. Possible tag overwrite — checking digests.
alex: running inspect: ```crane digest gcr.io/redwood/inference:canary-20260314 || gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood/inference:canary-20260314 --format='get(image_summary)'```
alex: different regions report different digests: sha256:aaa111... vs sha256:bbb222.... That looks like a mutable tag got overwritten mid-promotion.
maya: if tag mutated we should kill the rollout and rollback. Can we flip the canary flag now?
jonah: flipping feature flag: FF:inference_canary -> false. Command: ```curl -X POST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"inference_canary","value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'``` — done at 1935678920.
deploy-bot: Feature flag toggled by jonah; routing should stop within ~30s.
serena: starting immediate rollback to pinned stable digest: gcr.io/redwood/inference@sha256:ccc333 (stable-20260228). Doing: ```kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference inference=gcr.io/redwood/inference@sha256:ccc333 --record``` — rolling.
alex: CI/artifacts team — confirm how overwrite happened. Pipeline logs show initial push then a second push that reused same tag after a retry. Registry accepted overwrite because overwrite-allowed flag is set.
ci-artifact-team (hana): investigating. We see two push jobs; second push replaced layers and accepted same tag. We can disable tag overwrite in registry but need a short maintenance window.
maya: timeline: impact window ~1935678901 -> 1935678955 when rollback started (~54s). Need customer impact numbers.
jonah: quick metrics: global request volume 1.2M during window; canary subset ~1.1% of traffic. ~14k requests hit mutated canary, ~170 errors (5xx). Latency spiked on canary pods by ~120ms. No auth failures or data exfiltration seen.
hana: preparing support comms. Draft: "Intermittent inference errors for a subset of requests during a canary rollout due to artifact tag mutation in CI. Mitigation: disabled canary, rolled back to stable image. No customer data leaked."
maya: ops checklist: 1) confirm rollback complete; 2) purge/make immutable the mutated tag; 3) add CI guards to pin and verify digests; 4) postmortem owner(s).
serena: rollback finished at 1935678955, pods on stable digest. `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference -o wide` shows new pods on sha256:ccc333. Healthchecks trending back to baseline.
deploy-bot: health checks normalized; 5xx returned to baseline within ~60s after rollback.
alex: opening PR to enforce immutability: pipeline will push as digest, assert pushed digest == expected, and fail if overwrite detected. Also add retry behavior to fail fast.
ci-artifact-team (hana): registry team will disable tag overwrite in staging this afternoon; prod change needs scheduled window but prioritized.
jonah: handoff notes: I’ll update incident channel and create the mitigation timeline. @maya — please own drafting the customer-facing summary and severity update.
maya: will do. Postmortem owners: alex (CI) and serena (registry). Target: initial draft in 24h.
hana: support ticket created and stakeholders looped. Draft going to #support-review.
support-bot: Support ticket created: #INC-2039.
jonah: final check at 1935679035 — system green, closing active mitigation. Will link postmortem when ready.
